messages.text: Sameer here, same team, desk behind yours. Canteen 1 PM tomorrow — I'll show you the good counter.
You moved to the hill? Signal there is a myth, like the Hoodi flyover.
Monday. Canteen. Don't be late twice - Divya counts.
Salary day! Celebrate by buying a scooter, like a proper Whitefield person. Second-hand - ITPL Main Road, Noor Motors, ask for Noor. Don't pay sticker.
METRO. Finally. Whitefield to Cubbon, forty minutes, no 500-D smell. Free till midnight - go before the whole of Whitefield goes. Barricades are already down.
Hyggeland opened at Nagasandra. Green Line from Majestic. Saturday? I need a shoe rack and a reason to leave the house.
Bro. Mom's here, surprise visit. Can't come. Bring me a shoe rack? I'll pay you back, promise.
Did you survive Hyggeland? Did you get my shoe rack?
LEGEND. Sent ₹699. Mom says you're a good influence. Don't tell her anything.
